question: Estimate the daily Swiggy orders during a major cricket match (e.g., IPL final, India-Pakistan).
idealClarificationQuestions: Total orders during match-day in India? Yes.
All categories: Food + Instamart + Genie? Food + Instamart.
On match day (24 hours) or just during match window (~4 hours)? 24 hours.
vs an average non-match day? Yes — note multiplier.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Take Swiggy's average daily orders, apply match-day uplift multiplier driven by group viewing + order spike during innings break.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Swiggy average daily food orders FY26: ~2.5M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: 7-8 million orders on a major cricket match day.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Swiggy average daily food orders FY26

benchmarkAssumptions.value: 2-2.5x (peer households order during innings break, snacks/dinner all delivered during match window).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Plus Instamart match-day uplift (chips, beverages, ice cream)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: 7-8 million orders on a major cricket match day.

calculationFlow: Plus Instamart match-day uplift (chips, beverages, ice cream): ~1.8x normal day. Instamart normal ~1.2M = ~2.2M.
Round: 7-8 million orders on a major cricket match day.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: 7-8 million orders on a major cricket match day.
